g.text: Coarse-product heat estimates remain imprecise across restrictions

text.style: font-size: 5.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6f6f6f

g.text: All models use the prespecified NASA POWER heatwave definition and adjust for dewpoint, precipitation and wind. The diamond is the 228-stratum extended-cohort estimate; all intervals include one.
